verses.1: Oh, those who live in Zion and trust in Mount Moriah! They are the ancestors of the nations. They came to settle in Israel.
verses.2: Go through all these places, and see what happens there. Then go away from there with great fear. Choose the best among these kings; if their borders are far from your own borders.
verses.3: Those who are destined for a bad day, and they will be punished in Hell.
verses.4: They lie on straw and eat grass from the fields. They also eat sheep and goats from within the huts.
verses.5: The translations according to the Nabal’s words, as David said, were considered by them to be songs.
verses.6: The drinks were served in jars. The first two rows of seats were covered, and they weren’t used for seating.
verses.7: So now, they will be revealed in their true form, and they will be freed from their illusions.
verses.8: Praise the Lord, Jehovah, with all my heart! Praise Jehovah, God of hosts! I long for Jacob’s glory and his blessings. I desire to fill the city with joy and happiness.
verses.9: And if ten people were allowed to live in one room, they would all die.
verses.10: And the father lifted him up and brought him out of the house. He said to him, “Let those who are with you in the house also come out.” But he said, “No, I will not mention their names before Jehovah.”
verses.11: For behold, the LORD has commanded, and the great house was destroyed into pieces; the small house also was broken apart.
verses.12: May they be like horses in the stable; may they be used as a source of judgment and righteousness in the mornings.
verses.13: The rejoicing is not because of what they say. It’s because in our strength, we have been given those crowns.
verses.14: For I will build for you a house in Israel, says the LORD, the God of the armies of Israel. And I will bring about your redemption from the heathen until you come to the river Arbel.
